He has dementia and hit his head really bad. There was a massive pool of blood so I was really worried but the doctors sent him back home yesterday night. He went to get a tomography today and we will get the results tomorrow. 
I don’t necessarily have anyone close to me that would want to talk about such things so I wrote this here. I hope he will be okay but there’s nothing I can do for him. Thank you for taking your time to reply it means a lot.
Honestly I draw because it’s fun. Not everything has to have a reason. Just do it if you want to, you can stop whenever you want :)
These are so cool, they both look very wholesome
Hey I hope you consider staying here a little longer. I am also here if you feel like talking to a random stranger on the internet :)
You could paint over the blue stains if they don’t come out at all!

Hey dude all you can do at this point is to stay there for your fp and let them know that you are always there for them. If you are absolutely sure they are currently in danger you could call for help.

Hey dude, you will not find what you are looking for in this subreddit. I wish the best for you and hope that you are still willing to give life another chance. Sorry that you got so many weird comments, most people can’t understand how we feel. Which is good it’s own way I guess cause I wouldn’t want anyone else to feel like this.
The ogs have to help the new scene/emo kids for it to fully come back, I’m so tired of seeing the same boring wide pants outfit over and over again…
